ui.$description: UI short-name slot aliases — the W2-era token API still consumed by packages/ui component CSS and microsite-next's @theme bridge (census 2026-08-18: --copper ×5, --text-muted ×15, --accent-prime ×9, … referenced bare with no definition since the tiered rename). Each alias resolves to its tiered canon token so Storybook/ui/next rendering becomes honest (ADR-0003: S5 depends on S2 for exactly this). Purely additive for microsite-astro: none of these names are referenced there. The formerly-unresolvable semantic slots (--surface-page, --surface-inset, --rail-edge, --chrome-text/-hover/-active, --chrome-background, --chrome-border, --chrome-indicator, --grid-line) are RATIFIED per OQ-4 (AK 2026-08-18) as aliases with PROVISIONAL bindings into the ratified palette — DTCG 2025.10 makes unresolvable references a MUST-error, so bare-name ratification was never a legitimate intermediate state. The S5 story census amends any binding the rendered evidence disagrees with (a one-line re-point per alias); --chrome-* stays this small named set — no per-component tier (CD2 §10 Decision 13).
